cues: The box is insulated, so no heat enters.
And the gas pushes against nothing, so it does no work.
Q is zero and W is zero, so delta U is zero, and for an ideal gas, the temperature does not change at all.
A similar irreversible expansion through a porous plug is called a throttling process.
